name: Shadow Pursuit
source:
"Shadow Pursuit" is a compelling short detective story, brought to life by a solo developer without 3D expertise. With a concise yet intriguing plot, the game offers an interesting experience that captivates players from start to finish. Good art visuals enhance the overall atmosphere of the game. Step into the shoes of the protagonist and unravel the mysteries that await in this visually pleasing indie adventure.

You will be playing for main protagonist - detective John.

[From [url=https://pixeldreamer.itch.io/shadow-pursuit]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Shadow Pursuit》是一部引人入胜的短篇侦探故事，由一位没有3D专业知识的独立开发者将其变为现实。游戏情节简洁但引人入胜，为玩家提供了从头到尾吸引玩家的有趣体验。良好的艺术视觉效果增强了游戏的整体氛围。扮演主角，解开这场视觉上令人愉悦的独立冒险中等待着的谜团。

你将扮演主角——侦探约翰。

[来自[url=https://pixeldreamer.itch.io/shadow-pursuit]Itch.io[/url]]
